678-5865-6495.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
678-5865-6495.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat.
678-5865-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

539-1462-3821-4679-5231.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-1462-3821-4679-5231.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding {R}.
Repeat

1661-5078-7296-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3899-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
3899-5805--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

969-2034-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2232-7827-7831-7832.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7831-7832.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1453-6840-7503.easyPrerequisites: Arwen's toughness is greater than either Watchful Radstag's power or toughness, whichever is smaller, minus 2, for a minimum of 1 toughness.
1453-6840-7503.description:
Cast Elegant Entourage by paying {3}{G}. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters due to Arwen.
When Elegant Entourage enters, Watchful Radstag's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it. 
Watchful Radstag's second ability triggers, creating a token copy of it. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters due to Arwen.
When the token Watchful Radstag enters, the nontoken Watchful Radstag's evolve ability and Elegant Entourage trigger.
Resolve the Elegant Entourage trigger, giving Arwen +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Watchful Radstag trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2086-6996.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Repeat.

5147-5359-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5147-5359-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a number of creature tokens equal to its power.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

719-2366-5411-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
719-2366-5411-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

549-1978-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat

1387-1500-2100-5644-6898.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Judith trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

1818-2034-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1818-2034-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

4885-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

2457-3129-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1987-2239-2493-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2239-2493-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Ardent Elementalist.
When Archaeomancer and Ardent Elementalist enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-2493-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

290-1978-3488.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Katsumasa.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1789-2232-4336.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

379-1025-1581-4857.notablePrerequisites: Varragoth does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
379-1025-1581-4857.description:
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Activate Varragoth by paying {1}{B}, causing you to search your library for Stasis and put it on top of your library.
Activate Temple Bell by tapping it, causing each player to draw a card.
Cast Stasis by paying {1}{U}.
During the end step prior to your turn, activate Rishadan Pawnshop by paying {2} and tapping it, shuffling Stasis into your library from the battlefield.
Repeat.

628-997-2290.notablePrerequisites: Spike Feeder has no +1/+1 counters on it.
628-997-2290.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Spike Feeder.
Spike Feeder's undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain six life.
Repeat.

973-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2882-4675-4694-5052.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4694-5052.description:
Cast Kite Shield by paying {0}.
Kite Shield enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Kite Shield from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
